title: Document and pin the compact row state and optional-label contract
outcome: Compact row consumers have an explicit, tested contract for hybrid state values, absent empty labels, and UTF-8 title truncation.
acceptance: Contract comments record the lifecycle/availability invariant that makes the projection lossless.
Documentation defines state as open-item availability or non-open lifecycle and states that empty labels are omitted.
Parity coverage pins blocked JSON state, exact multibyte truncation behavior, and a label-free row shape.
